Thanks so much for tuning in to my 3TV Good Morning Arizona Segment featuring great ways AZ families can save on fall fun! If you haven’t already, I hope you’ll join the totally FREE Alicia’s Deals e-mail list here (unsubscribe at any time). Please tell a friend about my site, too, so we can all “live life better for less” together. Fall break is just around the corner, and if you plan ahead, you can save big!
Expedia is celebrating 30 years with sales of up to 30% off hotels and vacation rentals right now! The discount applies to properties all over the country, and their are tons of great deals close by. This is worth checking out for your fall break trip
The Beach Cottages in San Diego has rooms available in October for less on Expedia, including all taxes and fees, than you'd pay going through the hotel. This place is oceanfront and charming.
If San Diego sounds like fun, they are also offering all kinds of deals for families this October. They're bringing back the Kids Free San Diego all month.
SeaWorld is offering a free child ticket (ages 2-9) for each adult ticket purchased, and if you go through my authorized ticket link here, you'll save even more. You'll save $30 off the gate price and still get your free child ticket.
The San Diego Zoo is offering up to six free child tickets (ages 11 and under) for each paid adult in October.
If you want to go to Universal Studios a little further north, they're offering up to $100 off each ticket here. They're also offering up to $54 off Halloween Horror Night Tickets.
If you want to spend a couple of days at Disneyland, you can save up to $59 off each ticket.
I love paying less for tickets! I also love avoiding lines!
Enjoy and have a great fall break!

posts.title: Make an Appointment to Get a FREE Microchip for Your Owned Dog at the Maricopa County Animal Care and Control West Shelter!
posts.excerpt: If your dog doesn't have a Microchip, MCACC wants to give you one for free! Head over here to make an appointment at their West Shelter. Check out what they…
posts.text:
If your dog doesn't have a Microchip, MCACC wants to give you one for free! Head over here to make an appointment at their West Shelter. Check out what they say about it on their website:
"To help pet owners avoid the heartbreaking nightmare of searching for a missing pet, we are presenting Mission Microchip to offer free microchipping services through the end of the year.
We are offering appointments every day of the week at our West shelter. Registration is required ahead of time, and MCACC hopes all Maricopa County dog owners will take advantage of this free service.
Studies show that more than five million animals enter shelters nationwide each year. Of those shelter animals, forty to sixty percent are lost pets. The unfortunate reality is that one in three pets will go missing at some point, sometimes at no fault of the owner. Even the most well-behaved dogs can get lost or run off unexpectedly. Microchipping dogs not only greatly increases the chances of reuniting these lost dogs with their owners, but it may also help reduce the crowding problem shelters are facing all over the US.
To receive a microchip through the Mission Microchip event, please register for an appointment. Times open up two weeks in advance. Please check back daily if no appointments are available."
Please share this with someone who can benefit! Our pets are so precious!
Enjoy!

posts.excerpt: Alicia’s Deals may receive a small commission via affiliate links in this post. Please see my full disclosure here.
posts.text:

If you have a child who wants to learn to read or a child who is having trouble with reading, this book is incredible. Head over here to pick up Teach Your Child to Read in 100 Easy Lessons. It's currently $19.70 on Amazon (list price $27) but keep in mind they can raise prices at any moment.
This book helped me teach both of my children to read. The approach makes so much sense...it starts with the understanding of letters and how they sound when they're put together. I've known parents who were amazed at how much this book helped their kids improve in reading and in school in general. If your child is having trouble with reading, I really hope this book helps your family!
"With more than one million copies sold, Teach Your Child to Read in 100 Easy Lessons is a remarkable step-by-step, phonics-based program that teaches your child to read in just 20 minutes a day—with love, care, and joy a parent and child can share.
“[A] magical book...I’ve seen this method work in my own home, having used it with both of my children and watched that light go on.”—John McWhorter, The New York Times
Is your 4-year-old or even 3-year-old child expressing interest in reading, constantly pretending to read, and asking questions while you are reading? Do you want to develop a young reader but are unsure of how to do it? Is your child halfway through kindergarten and unable to read simple words without memorizing or guessing? Based on a novel by 19th-century romantic fabulist E.T.A. Hoffman, The Nutcracker weaves a magical tale of holiday adventure around one of the most recognizable scores in the ballet repertoire. It begins when young Clara receives a nutcracker from her godfather, a wizardly toymaker named Drosselmeyer. The “Waltz of the Snowflakes” floats weightlessly above the angelic voices, whereas the “Dance of the Sugarplum Fairy” tiptoes to the haunting, music-box chimes of a celesta. posts.title: Have You Gotten Your Truman Cleaning Supplies Yet? I am in Love!
posts.excerpt: Head over here to score 50% off a starter kit from Truman’s! This is cleaning that is SO much better for the earth (and the products are wonderful). I have…
posts.text:
Head over here to score 50% off a starter kit from Truman’s! This is cleaning that is SO much better for the earth (and the products are wonderful). I have been LOVING the products and the bottles are actually pretty nice looking (who knew that was a thing with cleaning supplies?)! You’ll pay $7.50 shipped if you want auto refills or $10 if you want to try it and not be locked into any other purchases (that’s what I did).
Check out their story:
“We started Truman’s because, while we’re somewhat obsessed with cleaning, we’re totally obsessed with reducing waste and clutter. Nowhere could we have a bigger impact than in the overcrowded world of home cleaning products, where so many specialized cleaners in plastic bottles clamor for our dollars with “fresh new scents” and trendy colors. Nobody needs a gazillion cleaning products with harsh chemicals cluttering their cabinets, and our planet certainly doesn’t need the plastic empties. That’s why we offer just 4 cleaners with refill cartridges — all non-toxic — that safely and effectively clean virtually all of your home’s hard surfaces. It’s a concept so novel that Fast Company has honored Truman’s as a World Changing Idea.
So that’s Truman’s. Cleaning glass and taking names.”
Check out the products:
“EVERYTHING AND THE KITCHEN SINK
There’s no use crying over spilled milk. Unless you were thirsty. Then cry.
The perfect combination of brains and brawn, I’m tough on grease but gentle on your surfaces. And just as my name implies, spray me on whatever you want in the kitchen. Except food. I’m non-toxic, but I’m also non-tasty. If you spray me on a food-bearing surface, be sure to rinse it before eating. (Our lawyers made us say that.)
If you’re dealing with a really nasty spill or grease buildup, let me sit there a little longer. Really, I don’t mind the wait. Whether you have fancy-schmancy marble countertops or a grill that hasn’t been scraped since the Cowboys’ last Super Bowl, I’m your cleaner. Now smother me with that wash rag and let’s do this.
FLOORS TRULY
Floors so clean you SHOULD eat off them.
I care deeply for the surface you touch the most — the floor. Ordinary cleaners can leave streaks or strip the finish off your floors. I won’t strip or streak in your home. You’re welcome.
My pH-neutral composition makes me the Switzerland of cleaning products and protects the integrity of your surfaces. And did I mention I’m completely non-toxic? Your dog, or your child, or your dog and your child, can roll around in puddles of me without harm. (Though that’d be weird, so it’s probably best if they don’t.)
Just spray me 6 to 8 inches from your target area, then spread my goodness around with a mop or dry cloth. Watch your floors sparkle like the 4th of July, courtesy of Floors Truly.
MORE SHOWER TO YOU
Maybe we should wait 30 or 45 minutes before we go in there.
Look, nobody likes cleaning a bathroom. I get it. Unspeakable things happen behind closed doors.
But take a deep breath (before entering), because we got this. I’m as non-toxic as your kitchen cleaner but specially formulated to tackle problems unique to bathrooms. I don’t just clean bathroom surfaces with soap scum, mineral deposits and water spots, I freaking emulsify them.
While your stuff don’t stink, most does. That’s why I deodorize while I clean. I’m basically the Justin Timberlake of bathroom cleaning. I can sing and dance, OK?
And once I’ve done my job, you can go back to reading the paper. Wait, nobody does that anymore? Chalk it up to another pastime ruined by the iPhone.
THE GLASS IS ALWAYS CLEANER
The days of streaking are over. But skinny-dipping is still OK.
Hey good lookin’. Why don’t you spritz a little bit of me on the mirror and brush your teeth with a view? Yeah, that’s better.
When you’re done checking yourself out, take me to the windows and…televisions? That’s right, I’m safe for use on TV screens and computer monitors, even cell phones and tablets. Just spray me onto a cloth first and then wipe gently. Fun fact: your phone is probably dirtier than your toilet. Swipe left for E. coli.
I’m ammonia free, streak free, toxin free, pretty much…free. Well, not totally. You still have to pay for me. “
We should all be as ecologically friendly as possible, and these products are a small way to help (plus I’m really excited about them)!
Enjoy!

"Highlights
A forest of suspended noodles and an enormous climbing structure engage the minds and hands of babies and children as old as 10
What You'll Get
Kids frolic among exhibits designed to foster creativity and skill development in babies to 10-year-olds.
Members and children younger than 1 are regularly admitted for free.
The Fine Print
Promotional value expires Nov 19, 2019. Amount paid never expires. Not valid with other offers or promotions. Merchant is solely responsible to purchasers for the care and quality of the advertised goods and services.
About Children's Museum of Phoenix
Although classrooms can be vibrant centers for learning, they’re usually stocked with pencils and notebooks instead of a forest of suspended green noodles or a flying bathtub with wings. At the Children's Museum of Phoenix, both of these engage young minds alongside other hands-on exhibits that have earned the museum a glut of awards, including a place among Parents magazine’s 10 Best Children’s Museums in 2011. The museum fosters creativity and skill development in children from birth to age 10 with open-ended play activities that range from bouncing orbs in the Grand Ballroom to building forts with a wealth of safe construction materials, instead of mom’s favorite sheets and a nail gun.
Perhaps the most eye-catching feature of the museum can be found in the atrium, where the Schuff-Perini Climber soars high into the air. Created from standard building materials, found objects, and out-of-context items such as its flying bathtub, the structure entices youths and inspires their imaginations. Another impressive contraption makes up the Whoosh! exhibit, where children feed scarves into a jumble of tubes that suck the fabrics up to heights of 20 feet before spitting them out to float gently down and be caught in waiting fingers. At each of these exhibits, a baby zone keeps the tiniest museum-goers safe, and they can find a space especially for them in the Place for Threes & Younger."
Enjoy!

The Nutcracker
Based on a novel by 19th-century romantic fabulist E.T.A. Hoffman, The Nutcracker weaves a magical tale of holiday adventure around one of the most recognizable scores in the ballet repertoire. It begins when young Clara receives a nutcracker from her godfather, a wizardly toymaker named Drosselmeyer. Sneaking downstairs to see the toy after everyone else has gone to bed, she suddenly finds herself caught in the middle of a pitched battle between the toys and an army of mice. After saving the nutcracker with a well-thrown shoe to the Mouse King’s head, Clara and her now-living prince venture into the Land of Snow and the Flowers to celebrate.
Throughout their adventures, Tchaikovsky’s dazzling inventiveness propels the dances of nimble flowers and regal fairy queens. The “Waltz of the Snowflakes” floats weightlessly above the angelic voices, whereas the “Dance of the Sugarplum Fairy” tiptoes to the haunting, music-box chimes of a celesta. A medley of exotic national dances—including a Spanish bolero and Russian Trepak—add to the phantasmagoric celebration before the whole dream ends, as all dreams must.

His expectation of finding it under the tree is slightly dimmed by the repeated exclamation of those around him, "You'll shoot your eye out!" This quirky tale from small-town America circa the 1940s is full of the humorous occurrences in a small boy's life. If you haven’t already, I hope you’ll join the totally FREE Alicia’s Deals e-mail list (unsubscribe at anytime). Please tell a friend about my site too so we can all “live life better for less” together. One of our favorite things to do each holiday season is take the kids to see The Nutcracker. Today you can head over here to score tickets at a big discount through Goldstar. I saw a ticket for as low as $29, Plus you can check and see if you have extra $10 off Karma codes to share with your friends.
Speaking of ballet, mark your calendar for September 22nd-30th. Ballet Arizona is presenting Ballet Under the Stars, completely FREE performances at five locations across the valley. They're going to Goodyear, Fountain Hills, Phoenix, Tempe, and Sun City West. This is a great way to expose the kids to ballet, or just enjoy the amazing Arizona weather.
If you could use a date night, keep in mind that Arizona Restaurant Week is coming September 16th-25th. This is the best week to try that restaurant you've been wanting to try forever. Make reservations NOW for places like T Cooks at the Royal Palms, Top of the Rock, El Charro, even chef Wiley's own Cafe Zuzu. There are three course menus that are $33 or $44, this is one of the best values in dining.
Speaking of Cafe Zuzu, it's fun the see the amazing chefs on Your Life A to Z and it's even more fun to visit them at their restaurants! Chef Wiley's restaurant has all kinds of great deals we can take advantage of so we won't break the bank. Every Sunday through Thursday after 3 PM through September 15th they're offering half off bottles of wine. On Wednesdays in the lounge they offer a wine tasting including information about how the wine is made. All night pours are just $6 each. Tonight they're featuring Dark Horse Chardonnay. On Thursday nights they do the same thing with whiskey.
Enjoy!

posts.title: Winner Picked for Dancing With the Stars Evening for Healing Hearts With Maks and Val Tomorrow! Enter Now!

posts.text:
Just a quick update that I'm picking winners TOMORROW (July 29th)! This will be an AMAZING EVENT!
If you’ve been reading Alicia’s Deals for awhile, you know that Healing Hearts Animal Rescue is one of my favorite charities in the valley. They rescue, rehabilitate and adopt out Arizona’s abused, neglected, and abandoned horses and other animals in need. You can read more about the organization and the work they do on their website. They have an amazing fundraising event “Horse Power with Star Power” coming up August 8th from 6-9 PM. Tickets are usually $350 a pair and they gave a set to give away!
Check out the details about the evening: “Join Healing Hearts for a once-in-a-lifetime event on August 8th! First, set your eyes on some of the world’s most exotic cars, then enjoy organic eats, cocktail drinks, and meet & greet two of the hottest stars of ABC’s hit show Dancing with the Stars, Maks and Val Chmerkovskiy!” The leading sponsors of the unforgettable night include Barrett Jackson, The Jackson Family Foundation, Bondurant Racing, PHXGT, Gemini Acres Equine & Grimaldi’s.
You can buy tickets and find out more about the night here (there are a limited number of tickets available). I always try to go to their events and love seeing Alicia’s Deals readers who go! If you buy a pair and you’re the big winner they told me they’ll refund your money (I’ll have no idea who has bought tickets).
To enter to win, send me an e-mail (alicia@dealsinaz.com) and let me know that you’d like to go! I also hope that you’ll join the FREE Alicia’s Deals e-mail list (unsubscribe at anytime). I send one e-mail a day that I hope helps you “live life better for less” and brightens your afternoon. Also, if you’re on facebook, please “like” Healing Hearts Animal Rescue and Alicia’s Deals.
I’ll pick the lucky winner on July 29th.
Good luck!

This is where Pluto was discovered and it's always a fun and informative place. The telescopes are amazing!
Head over here to get passes for a family of four to the AZ Snowbowl chairlift ride for $45 ($76 value). This is a beautiful, COOL escape from the heat! You can get two tickets for $23 (a $38 value).
“The scenic chairlifts drop passengers off at 11,500 feet to the peak of an extinct volcano, where, depending on the weather, they can see for up to 70 miles around. The trip takes about 25 minutes each way, with plenty of time at the top for sightseeing. Forest service rangers are on hand to point out landmarks—including the Grand Canyon, cinder-cone volcanic fields, and Sedona’s red rocks—and educate visitors about the alpine tundra beneath their feet. Passengers ages 5 and under ride free. Scenic chairlift rides operate Friday—Monday from 10 a.m. to 4 p.m., May 22 through mid-October.”
Heading to Prescott? Click here to get half off tickets to the Heritage Park Zoological Sanctuary.
"Heritage Park and its volunteers are dedicated to the conservation and protection of wildlife, caring for more than 150 indigenous and exotic mammals, reptiles, and birds in a 10-acre haven. Many of Heritage Park's animals were previously injured, abandoned, or marked with a human imprint that prevents them from rejoining their packs without bringing personalized coffee mugs for everyone. While prowling through the sanctuary, visitors might spy a mountain lion that was kept as a pet, a black bear that was orphaned by his mother, or a fox rescued from a swimming pool. Emus, tarantulas, and ring-tailed lemurs also run free in their habitats, serenading onlookers with their wild cries.
Heritage Park also plays an important role in the Association of Zoos & Aquariums’ Species Survival Plan, granting asylum to critically endangered Mexican gray wolves, which are being reintroduced into the wild after a 20-year absence. The zoological sanctuary is open every day, with extended hours from May 1 to October 31 to give guests a chance to see animals that are usually out running errands during business hours."
No matter where you're going, you'll probably want a few fireworks! You DON'T have to pay full price!
Click here to get $40 to spend at Davey Jones Fireworks Superstore for $23. They have 11 locations around town.
Click here to get $20 to spend at TNT Fireworks stands and tents for $10. There are lots of locations throughout the state.
Have a great time!

posts.text:

If you’re new to the site (WELCOME!), I put together a post of shopping secrets at all of the valley grocery stores here. If you're new to the site, this is a GREAT place to start!
Click here to download a coupon for $2 off your $40 purchase onto your Fry’s VIP card. It never works on my mobile device for some reason and you must have facebook to get the coupon. So bummed that Fry’s did away with all coupons being worth $1.
Download the Ibotta app here if you haven’t already. I LOVE IT and think everyone should have it! You can get money back from your purchases at grocery stores including Sprouts, Fry’s, Safeway, Whole Foods, and more(think cereal, ice cream, Halloween candy, milk, orange juice, soda, bread, eggs, Shout, Ritz, wine, cookies, t0matoes, butter, nuts, and lots more), CVS Pharmacy, Target, Walmart, Walgreens, Costco, Sam’s Club, restaurants like Quizno’s and Chili’s, Home Depot and Lowe’s, PetSmart and Petco, Babies r Us, AMC Theatres, and more. It’s super easy to use once you get the hang of it and makes shopping way more fun. The cash back is in addition to any sales or coupons you have, and it goes right into your Paypal account (or you can get gift cards). You just redeem the offer and upload a picture of your receipt…super easy.
Click here to get to coupons.com and print off any printable coupons you think you’ll use. This week you can save big at Safeway as all manufacturer’s coupons are worth at least $1 (makes the $.10 off coupon look a lot more attractive…dollars add up FAST)! Note that Fry’s does not make all coupons worth at least a buck anymore.

For my KTAR video this week I decided to focus on ways your smart phone and computer can save you money...no coupons required! You can watch it above, if you're new to the site, this is a great place to start!
I’ve been saying forever that you can get all of the deals at all of the stores at Walmart and you don’t have to have the ad. Well their brand new Savings Catcher is changing the game completely. Head over here to watch a quick video about it. Even if you never, ever look at the grocery ads (or the weekly post I do with all of my favorite deals) you can STILL get the best deals from everywhere at Walmart. What you do is scan your receipt on the Walmart app or enter your receipt number on Walmart’s website. If they find another price from an ad that’s lower than what you paid they’ll give you the difference in a Walmart e gift card. It’s all automatic and you can use it in store or online. If you really don’t want to tell the cashier about lower prices you found at different stores, this is a great bet for you.
Target has a great app called Cartwheel...head over here to check it out. Even if you don't have a phone you can still get an account on your computer. You'll enjoy big savings on all kinds of things already on your list. The savings are good on top of any Target coupons or manufacturers coupons you have.
If you haven’t gotten the Ibotta app yet, click here. They will pay you for learning about and shopping for selected items (in addition to any sales or coupons you have). It makes going to the grocery store way more fun. They have extra offers at Target, Whole Foods, Walmart, Costco, and Sams Club too! Ibotta-supported stores nearby include Fry’s, Safeway, Walmart, Whole Foods, CVS Pharmacy, Walgreens, Target, 7-eleven, Sam’s Club, Costco, and a few others (NOT Bashas’, Albertsons, or Trader Joe’s). I have gotten literally hundreds of dollars back!
Your grocery store has probably caught up with the digital age too! Head over here to get the Just for U app. You can save up to 30% off your grocery purchases! The savings are on many things you usually buy (where it gets the Just for U name).

posts.title: Tips and Tricks to Save You Money Every Single Day!
posts.excerpt: Video
posts.text:
Video
If you missed Your Life A to Z today, you can watch it above!
Looking for deals is exciting! If you keep these tips and tricks in mind, you'll save even more every single day! Did you have any idea that it's possible to stack FOUR promo codes together sometimes?!
I hope you'll "like" Alicia's Deals on facebook, follow me on Twitter, and join the Alicia’s Deals e-mail list here. I'll do my very best to help you "live life better for less" every single day!
If you take a few moments each week checking out the ads (or reading my weekly best deals at the grocery stores post), you can save HUGE at Walmart. You can ad match and you don't have to physically have the ad with you!
Head over here to check out their ad match guarantee.
Here are a few highlights:
“We will match any local competitor’s advertised price.
We do not require customers to have the ad with them to honor a competitor’s ad. (this is HUGE…people think it’s really hard and they have to actually have the ads with them)
Items purchased must be identical to the ad (size, quantity, brand, flavor, color, etc.), for fresh produce and meat items, the price is offered in the same unit type (lb. for lb; each for each)”
If you’ve been reading Alicia’s Deals in AZ for awhile, you know how much I love Ibotta. This app allows you to save even more on things you’re already buying (on top of any sales or coupons). I have saved $643 total with this app…I just got $.25 back from milk! You can get money back from purchases like sunscreen, milk, soap, pork ribs, wine, and more at grocery stores including Sprouts, Fry’s, Safeway, Whole Foods, and more(think milk, sunscreen, Blue Bunny ice cream, soap,and lots more), CVS Pharmacy, Target, Walmart, Walgreens, Costco, Sam’s Club, restaurants like Quizno’s and Chili’s, Home Depot and Lowe’s, PetSmart and Petco, Babies r Us, AMC Theatres, and more. It’s super easy to use once you get the hang of it and makes shopping way more fun. The cash back is in addition to any sales or coupons you have, and it goes right into your Paypal account (or you can get gift cards). You just redeem the offer and upload a picture of your receipt…super easy. They are always adding new products that qualify for cash back.
Don't forget to use promo codes! I am always finding promo codes for all kinds of stores, even Groupon, Living Social, and Deal Chicken. In fact at Deal Chicken, you can always get $15 off your $75 purchase with promo code ALICIA15. Savings on top of savings are the BEST KIND! Keep in mind that you can often STACK promo codes.
At Kohl's, I just put FOUR promo codes TOGETHER, click here to find out EXACTLY how I did it. When you're able to stack codes, you'll do so much better!
You don't have to pay a ton to keep the kiddos entertained! My kids have done Apple Camp for two years in a row now. You can head over here to find out more about this FREE program. They got great instruction along with free ear buds and a free t shirt! Spots go quickly so you'll definitely want to sign up early next year!
Lowe's offers a fun and FREE kids clinic twice a month. Head over here to sign up for the next one.
Home Depot offers free kids workshops the first Saturday of each month. Head over here for more information!
Enjoy the deals and "live life better for less" every single day!

posts.text:
Thanks for tuning into the noon news on KTAR today! Check out my favorite deals for your weekend (and please "like" my facebook page for even more great deals):
Today you can head over here to take 15% off the Living Social deal of your choice with promo code 15OFFMAY. That means you can score $20 to spend at Arcadia Tavern for $8.50. You can also choose a year's worth of facials, peels, or microdermabrasions at Skin Gravy in Gilbert for just $84.50, just over ten bucks each. You can only use the code once so choose carefully! Savings on top of savings never get old.
You can head over here to take 15% off a Groupon top travel pick with promo code TOP15 (expires 5/16). That could mean a night at the Hard Rock Cafe Hotel in Las Vegas for around $40 or another fun getaway for a lot less.
Going to see Godzilla this weekend? Head over here where you can score a ticket to Studio Movie Grill for just five bucks. For an extra dollar fifty you can actually reserve your seats online!
Doesn't jet skiing sound fun? Head over here and use promo code ALICIA15 to get a four-hour rental at Bartlett Lake for just $74, a $185 value. The same code will get you six tickets to Big Surf for just $11.45 each, usually $27.95. You can use this code as many times as you want.
It's Friday and that means freebies. Head over here to add a coupon for a FREE bag of Twistos baked snacks worth $2.79 to your VIP card. I tried the bruchetta flavor and it's pretty good. You must download the coupon today (Friday) but you'll have until 5/31 to redeem it.
All week long I've been doing a series about how to save the most money where you shop. Head over here to find savings tips and secrets you might not know about at Target, Fry's, Safeway, Walmart, and CVS. You'll save big even when there isn't a sale.
Enjoy the deals!
